evidence.why: Source declares slot and team as u8.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unrestricted integer-domain claim while preserving the exact ordinary mapping, destination conversions, and adjacent CPU overwrite.
facts.value: Immediately writes the supplied int slot plus one to the u8 slot field, then maps input 2 to team 3 and input 3 to team 2, otherwise assigning the input to the u8 team field. Inputs 0, 1, 2, and 3 therefore produce slot/team pairs 1/0, 2/1, 3/3, and 4/2. Other inputs undergo unsigned-byte conversion on assignment; the routine performs no validation, and slot + 1 must be representable as int for defined C arithmetic. CPU setup subsequently replaces the resulting team with 4.

evidence.why: Both inline helpers and the complete exported transformation.

facts.rationale: Uses the current timer field name and preserves the complete numeric qualification branches instead of conflating qualification with raw stock count.
facts.value: Forces MatchKind_Stock, disables timer_enabled, and clears rules.x2_5. Slots already Gm_PKind_NA are skipped. For each other slot, a qualifying value defaults to 1; when end->match_kind is numerically 1, timeout returns recorded stocks, while a non-timeout returns stocks if player_standings[i].x28 < frame_count or the stocks value converted to u8 is nonzero. Otherwise it falls back to 1, including zero stocks at or after frame_count. A slot is retained only if this value is positive and its relevant is_big_loser flag is zero: team standing is used when end->is_teams == 1, otherwise player standing. Retained players receive stocks = 1 and x12 = 300; character kinds 0x12/0x13 become 0x13 when fighter kind is 7 and 0x12 otherwise. Rejected occupied slots become Gm_PKind_NA. Other fields are preserved.
